caption:
Norse Atlantic files for bankruptcy in Europe

The Norwegian low-cost airline, founded only a few years ago, had struggled to turn a profit before fuel prices spiked. Norse Atlantic said it failed to secure funding. Soaring fuel costs, driven by the war in Iran, strained its operations. The company filed on Friday.

Reported by DW; CNBC.
